title: Factorial approximation ratio identity
statement: For each nonnegative integer $m$, write $A(m)=\sqrt{2m\pi}\,(m/e)^m$, where $e=\exp(1)$. For positive integers $r$ and $k$, define $C(r,k)=\sqrt{2rk\pi}/(\sqrt{2k\pi})^r$. Then $A(rk)/(A(k)^r r^{rk})=C(r,k)$.
